data.action: 单膝跪地献放白花，双手合拢垂首默祷，赤发与黑军装在晚风中轻扬
data.camera: cowboy shot, solemn low angle, warm rim light, memorial atmosphere
data.description: 【基地纪念墙前·黄昏】染血赤发在晚风中轻扬，身着黑色军装的蕾娜单膝跪在刻满名字的纪念墙前，将一束白花轻轻放下。黑裙、黑靴与黑手套勾勒出肃穆的剪影，唯有那缕赤红发丝像不肯熄灭的火种。她合拢双手垂首默祷，银灰的睫毛在颤动，坚强与哀恸在她脸上达成了完美的平衡。
data.lighting: 低角度橙金夕照为黑色军装镶上暖边，白花高光纯净
data.location: 基地纪念广场刻名墙前
data.promptProse: Before the base memorial wall, Vladilena Milize kneels on one knee to place white flowers beneath the engraved names, then folds her hands and lowers her head. Her black uniform and boots form a still silhouette beneath the single red streak in her silver bangs. The low cowboy view follows the wall's perspective behind. Orange-gold sunset edges her jacket and hair, lighting the flowers against the darker stone and long ground shadow.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 黑色军装的追悼白花·「鲜血女王绝不会忘记任何一个名字」
